name: CI cache negative tests failed — a routed job could write a shared cache or found a writer credential
description: Fires when a cache-negative-tests job (workflow 'CI cache negative tests' in livespec-dev-tooling, every 6 h on the pool) concludes failure in the trailing 4 h. The job runs ci-runner/k3s/phase2/isolation/cache-negative-tests.sh FROM INSIDE a routed container job and fails when a job CAN write the warm-cache mount, CAN SET into the sccache redis with the pod's credentials, HOLDS a writer credential, or CAN write the crates proxy — or when a precondition (the template's mount, a reachable redis/proxy) is missing, which is a misconfigured pool, not a pass. Any firing is a trust-boundary breach or a broken tier: read the job log (gh run list --repo thewoolleyman/livespec-dev-tooling --workflow 'CI cache negative tests'), then the hook template / ACL / nginx config it names. Data: .github/scripts/export-ci-telemetry.sh. v054 §'Runner-pool cache telemetry' Negative tests; livespec-dev-tooling-tqpszl, plan ci-runner-cache-tiers.
